name: Oakpointe
summary:
Every Autumn, we acknowledge the passing of seasons by celebrating the macabre, making the most of the thinning veil, and steeling ourselves for the coming winter. This is also, by all accounts, an excellent time of year for a nice walk.

Oakpointe is a lo-fi walking sim, made over three weeks during October '26 as an aesthetic tribute to the season. Make yourself a mug of tea, zone out, and enjoy a long walk through a sprawling, procedural suburb.
